notes.title: Update v0.2025.184.1
notes.content:
Several minor bugfixes in content.

For those having difficulty launching the game on Windows, a new Launch Option is available to force DirectX 12 mode. If the game exits shortly after launch on your machine, you can try this mode:

[olist]
[*] Right-click on LongStory 2 in your Steam Library
[*] Select "Properties..."
[*] Under "General" > "Launch Options", input `--dx12`
[/olist]

As always we appreciate the bug reports and feedback. Thank you!
